name: level-3-props
notes: Level 3 Quiapo Underground Chapel props (issue #13). Generated on a #fd6cf7 key with every prop separated by clear key (no erase cuts needed), then soft-keyed to alpha with key unmixing so edges carry no magenta fringe; RGB under alpha 0 is still #fd6cf7. Native 1280x720 source packed at scale 1 (same on-screen density as the L1/L4 2816-wide sheets at 0.5). Dressing extras for #14 sit in a new row at y>=808 (hint_prints, hint_eyes, spikes, damp_floor, hint_silhouette). The 720-800 band is left as key so PR #45 can add footprint_back as r3f0 in that row; after #45 lands these five frames become r4f0-r4f4.
